english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is important or of great value.
This is the all-purpose choice for something indispensable or very important.
This is the all-purpose choice for something important or having a major effect.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when “central” means very important.
This is the all-purpose choice when “critical” means extremely important.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that is extremely important, essential, or vital.
This is the all-purpose choice for something very important or necessary, without stressing that it is absolutely indispensable.
Use this when “essential” means highly important rather than required.
This is the all-purpose choice when major means important or significant.
Use this when “serious” means important or significant, without necessarily implying danger or severity.
Use 重要 when considerable means significant or worthy of attention, especially for a person, role, or issue.
Use this when “big” means important or significant rather than physically large.
Use this when “prominent” means important or having a significant role rather than merely being famous.
Choose this when “significant” means important or consequential.
